pluginSettingsPanel.local-plugins-with-worker-js-are-trusted: Local plugins with worker.js are trusted code; page plugins run in a restricted iframe. Workers cannot stop malicious code from accessing local resources.
pluginSettingsPanel.the-installed-plugin-directory-is-delete: The installed plugin directory is deleted. Choose whether to also delete this plugin’s stored data and logs.

starSyncPanel.choose-what-the-sync-button-pulls-by-def: Choose what the sync button pulls by default: starred repos only, or starred repos plus GitHub Lists.
starSyncPanel.also-pull-github-lists-categorize-by-tag: Also pull GitHub Lists & categorize by tags
starSyncPanel.write-each-local-category-to-a-github-li: Write each local category to a GitHub List of the same name. Same-name lists are overwritten, missing lists are created.

themeSettingsCard.switch-the-interface-color-scheme-instan: Switch the interface color scheme instantly; changes apply and persist automatically.

vectorSearchSettings.semantic-search-powered-by-cloudflare-ve: Semantic search powered by Cloudflare Vectorize. Understands natural language intent to find semantically related repositories.
vectorSearchSettings.when-enabled-ai-search-will-use-vector-r: When enabled, AI search will use vector retrieval first, with automatic fallback on failure
vectorSearchSettings.ollama-local-models-can-leave-this-empty: Ollama local models can leave this empty
vectorSearchSettings.recommended-4000-8000-longer-higher-prec: Recommended 4000-8000. Longer = higher precision but slower indexing
vectorSearchSettings.higher-stricter-fewer-but-more-precise-r: Higher = stricter, fewer but more precise results; Lower = more recall but may include noise
vectorSearchSettings.max-results-from-vector-search-more-wide: Max results from vector search. More = wider recall but higher LLM reranking cost
vectorSearchSettings.ai-generates-ideal-repo-description-befo: AI generates ideal repo description before searching, improves recall for short/Chinese queries
vectorSearchSettings.llm-reranks-vector-results-by-semantic-r: LLM reranks vector results by semantic relevance, significantly improves ranking quality
vectorSearchSettings.if-you-changed-the-embedding-model-diffe: If you changed the Embedding model (different dimensions), you need to delete the old index and recreate it.
vectorSearchSettings.run-these-commands-in-the-cloudflare-wor: Run these commands in the cloudflare-worker directory, then click "Rebuild Vector Index" above
vectorSearchSettings.note-redeployment-does-not-require-recre: Note: Redeployment does not require recreating the Vectorize index. Existing vector data is preserved.
vectorSearchSettings.must-rebuild-index-after-changing-embedd: Must rebuild index after changing Embedding model
vectorSearchSettings.different-models-produce-vectors-with-di: Different models produce vectors with different dimensions. After changing model: ① Delete old index and create new one (dimensions must match) ② Click "Rebuild Vector Index" below

webDAVPanel.the-stored-webdav-password-could-not-be-: The stored WebDAV password could not be decrypted. Please re-enter and save this configuration.
webDAVPanel.click-the-button-above-to-add-webdav-con: Click the button above to add WebDAV configuration
